name: Motivation
blurb: A push to start the day
brief: An original motivational line about effort, starting, and showing up. Plain words, no cliches like 'rise and grind'.

name: Discipline
blurb: Habits, focus and doing it anyway
brief: An original line about discipline, habits, focus or consistency. Concrete, blunt, slightly warm.

name: Money
brief: An original line of timeless money wisdom: saving, spending, patience, ownership. No specific investment advice, no tickers, no numbers that could be wrong.

name: Mindset
blurb: How to think about hard days
brief: An original line about mindset: perspective, setbacks, fear, self-talk. Calm and honest, not preachy.

name: One fact a day
brief: One surprising but well-established fact from science, history, nature or the human body. It must be accurate and widely documented. Avoid exact figures unless they are certain. Write it as one plain sentence, not a question.

name: Book ideas
blurb: One idea from a great book
brief: One key idea from a well-known non-fiction book, written entirely in your own words. Never quote the book. The credit must be: Idea from <Book title> by <Author>.

name: Stoic
brief: One Stoic idea from Seneca, Epictetus or Marcus Aurelius, rewritten in your own modern words. Never quote them directly. The credit must be: After <Name>.
